context: Evaluate a blunt stand-up bit about wedding speeches for unhedged delivery, genuine escalation, and originality.

checklist.name: unhedged_opening_line
checklist.description: The opening line is a single sentence stated as settled fact, with no softening qualifiers.

checklist.name: escalating_followup
checklist.description: The line after the opening claim extends or worsens the claim rather than softening, hedging, or apologizing for it.

checklist.name: no_reproduction
checklist.description: No line matches or closely paraphrases an identifiable real comedian's specific routine or wording.

checklist.name: sustained_bluntness
checklist.description: The bit maintains flat, matter-of-fact delivery throughout, with no reassurance or disclaimer inserted anywhere after the blunt claim.
